title: When the Winter Turns
author: Kestrel Joubert
blurb: Sebastian Nakamura, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
